We need to determine appropriate charge(s) based on facts. The case: driver without professional driving license, operating a loader (装载机) and hits a pedestrian causing death. Likely "过失致人死亡" (negligent homicide) or "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident causing death). In Chinese criminal law, causing death by dangerous driving without license could be "交通肇事罪" (traffic accident罪). The prior examples: they used "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营" for a construction vehicle accident. That case: driver of a loader (铲车) reversed and hit a cyclist, causing death. They labeled "过失致人死亡;破坏生产经营". So similar scenario: operating loader, causing death. Also maybe "无证驾驶" is an administrative offense, not criminal. So likely "过失致人死亡". Also maybe "破坏生产经营"? In that prior case, they added "破坏生产经营" because the driver was on a construction site? The fact says "在滑县新区宣武新村工地驾驶铲车装土" (on a construction site). That might be considered "破坏生产经营" (disrupting production). In current case, location: "北京市昌平区南口镇某洞由北向南300米左右路东处" (a road). Not a construction site. So maybe only "过失致人死亡". Also could be "交通肇事罪". But the label set used earlier didn't include "交通肇事罪". They used "过失致人死亡". So we follow that.

Thus answer: [罪名]过失致人死亡<eoa>
